housing.summary: Numbeo's August 2026 contributor-based average for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment is EUR 784.92 per month. Source: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Bordeaux For an unfurnished lease, France's statutory deposit cap is one month of rent excluding charges. Source: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F31269 SeLoger lists Bordeaux rentals. Source: https://www.seloger.com/immobilier/tout/immo-bordeaux-33/

banking.summary: BNP Paribas requires France-resident adult applicants to present valid identity and proof of address less than three months old; hosted applicants also need a signed hosting certificate plus the host's identity and address documents. Source: https://mabanque.bnpparibas/fr/gerer/comptes-et-formules/compte-individuel
required_docs: Valid identity document: national identity card, passport, or residence permit
Original proof of address less than three months old
If hosted: signed hosting certificate plus host's proof of address and identity document

schools.summary: Bordeaux International School documents French and British national curricula in primary, and Cambridge International Education leading to IGCSE and International A Level in upper school. Sources: https://www.bordeaux-school.com/learning/primary https://www.bordeaux-school.com/learning/upper-school The City of Bordeaux school directory is at https://www.bordeaux.fr/ecoles

legal_admin.summary: A non-EU newcomer holding a VLS-TS must validate it online and pay the tax within three months after arrival; the visa then serves as the residence permit for its validity period. Source: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F16162
legal_admin.registration_step: Validate the VLS-TS online within three months of arrival and pay the required tax

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer without a numéro fiscal obtains the 13-digit identifier after filing the first income-tax return on paper with the required supporting documents; the tax administration then assigns the number. Source: https://www.impots.gouv.fr/particulier/questions/comment-creer-mon-espace-finances-publiques

transport.summary: TBM is Bordeaux's tram, bus, boat and park-and-ride network; its standard monthly pass for ages 28-59 costs EUR 55.00 and is valid for one calendar month. Source: https://boutique.infotbm.com/products/23
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A non-EEA licence is valid for one year from acquiring normal residence; exchange is required to keep driving after that and is possible only when the licence and issuing country meet the conditions. Source: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F1460
transport.healthcare_registration: Send completed Cerfa S1106 and situation-specific identity, residence-status and eligibility documents to the health-insurance fund for the place of residence; this opens rights and produces a temporary NIA while identity is certified. Source: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-france/ne-etranger-demander-numero-securite-sociale
